title: Incident Closure Packet: Tiered Customer Briefings, Staged Statuspage Edits, and Follow-up Workstreams
creator: Maya Kannan
description: Purpose: Produce a single incident closure packet that ties together the public statuspage narrative, tiered customer briefings (by SLA tier), and the tracked engineering follow-ups required to prevent recurrence. Outcome should be: a polished statuspage timeline, outbound templates for affected customers, a prioritized set of engineering action items with owners and due dates, and a single confluence postmortem for release to stakeholders.

comms_plan: Step 0 (immediate): Post minimal incident stub on statuspage with incident id and ETA for RCA (statuspage incident: INC-2026-032).
Step 1 (24h): Publish initial status update summarizing impact windows and mitigation steps taken. Include contact for enterprise customers to request bridge calls.
Step 2 (RCA draft): Share a non-technical customer-facing summary within 5 business days, and a technical appendix (confluence) for technical contacts. Legal to review before release.
Step 3 (targeted outreach): Send tailored emails to top 20 affected customers with offer for a dedicated briefing and compensatory credits if SLA breached.
Step 4 (final): Update statuspage with postmortem link and list of completed follow-ups. Publish timeline and next steps.
Fallback: If fixes require >30 days, communicate a monthly progress bulletin and a public mitigations roadmap.
Tone guidance: Empathetic, accountable, concise; avoid speculative root-cause attribution until internal RCA is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Public statuspage updated with a clear timeline and link to postmortem within 7 business days.
Top-tier customers contacted with a customized briefing offer within 48 hours of ticket assignment.
All engineering action items have owners, estimates, and tracked due dates in this ticket or linked sub-issues.
Monitoring and replay artifacts attached to confluence postmortem for internal verification.

risk_assessment: Medium-High: recurrence risk remains until autoscaler regression and KV-cache telemetry are validated. Customer churn risk elevated for customers experiencing repeated latency spikes.
closure_notes: TBD: final closure will require confirmation of fixes in production for two full business cycles and positive validation from at least 3 enterprise customers who participated in canary calls.
